title: MatFormer mix-and-match Mirror layer codes
hypothesis: Layer-indexed Mirror granularity codes improve held-out mixed-width submodels beyond native nested FFN selection while storing less than flat and direct coefficient controls.
mirror_coordinate: per-layer width code composed into a logical submodel
logical_multiplicity: 27 width assignments, six locked held-out mixes measured

development.selection_metric: held-out operator nMSE, distinct functions, actual bytes

fresh.reason: Direct factorized coefficient control tests Mirror specificity.

success_gate: Held-out nMSE <=1e-6; >=10% fewer bytes than flat; >=10% fewer than direct coefficient control.
failure_gate: Direct coefficients match Mirror or held-out nMSE gate fails.
boundaries: no actual MatFormer training or LM claim
